feature: script-first repository preflight, approved feature-branch publication and evidence receipt
scope: trusted-local; requested follow-up, not a new mandatory milestone

focusedTests.command: uv run --offline --no-project python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_publish.py -v
focusedTests.git: real temporary repositories and local bare remotes
focusedTests.paperclip: HTTP boundary fixture; native server not started
focusedTests.github: account-denial external gh response fixture; no live push

regressionEvidence: Read-only preflight and exact plan/tree/diff SHA-256 binding
Dirty files, untracked work, staged work and index bytes preserved
Candidate history flattened; unrelated intermediate commits excluded
Stale or incomplete approval, non-owner/agent/deleted comment and wrong plan denied
Wrong remote/account, protected branch and out-of-scope changes denied
Live remote base must equal approved base before a new push
Concurrent branch creation denied by empty expected-ref creation-only CAS
Lost push response reconciled by exact remote SHA; absent uncertain push not retried
Lost receipt response reconciled without duplicate POST; pending receipt can resume
Receipt replay idempotent; unrelated or empty existing receipt not overwritten
API redirect does not forward board credentials
Git replacement refs ignored and hidden submodule changes remain scope-checked

review.findings: replacement refs; ignored submodule diff; index stat-cache mutation
review.resolution: each reproduced RED then fixed; focused/full suites GREEN
review.method: read-only static re-review; no live runtime claim

taskAuthority: Paperclip; local receipt is external-write evidence only
limits: No PR creation, merge, deployment, fetch/import or service lifecycle automation
No automatic task approval or model/workflow changes
GitHub SSH configuration remains trusted; gh check is not SSH-key identity proof
No atomic cross-system transaction between approval revocation and Git push
Completed stage flags are not independent proof of exact reviewer-tested bytes
Live GitHub and Paperclip publication remains to be exercised on an actually approved task
